entities.summary: The As-Sajadah Mosque, also known as Asy-Syukr Mosque or Abi Dzar Mosque, is a Sunni Islam mosque, located 900 metres (3,000 ft) north of Al-Masjid an-Nabawi in Medina, Saudi Arabia.
